sourceTitle: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
originalTitle: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: The buildings haven’t changed. Everything around them has.
blocks.en: The buildings haven’t changed. Everything around them has.
blocks.zh: 楼宇没有变。围绕楼宇的一切却变了。

blocks.text: A hundred years ago, managing a residential building meant finding tenants, collecting rent and keeping properties in good condition. Today, these fundamentals remain remarkably similar. What is changing is how that work gets done.
blocks.en: A hundred years ago, managing a residential building meant finding tenants, collecting rent and keeping properties in good condition. Today, these fundamentals remain remarkably similar. What is changing is how that work gets done.
blocks.zh: 一百年前，管理住宅楼意味着寻找租户、收取租金，以及保持物业状况良好。时至今日，这些基本工作仍然大同小异。正在改变的，是完成这些工作的方式。

blocks.text: For European residential real estate operator Heimstaden, this presents an opportunity: what if AI could fundamentally change how thousands of homes are managed?
blocks.en: For European residential real estate operator Heimstaden, this presents an opportunity: what if AI could fundamentally change how thousands of homes are managed?
blocks.zh: 对欧洲住宅房地产运营商 Heimstaden 而言，这意味着一个机遇：如果 AI 能从根本上改变数千套住宅的管理方式，会怎样？

blocks.text: In June 2025, Heimstaden’s leadership decided to accelerate its bet on AI. After evaluating several platforms, the company chose OpenAI. The goal was twofold; empower employees and rethink the processes at the heart of its business.
blocks.en: In June 2025, Heimstaden’s leadership decided to accelerate its bet on AI. After evaluating several platforms, the company chose OpenAI. The goal was twofold; empower employees and rethink the processes at the heart of its business.
blocks.zh: 2025 年 6 月，Heimstaden 管理层决定加快对 AI 的投入。在评估了多个平台后，公司选择了 OpenAI。目标有两个：赋能员工，以及重新思考核心业务流程。

blocks.text: The ambition is to move towards increasingly self-operating buildings, where AI can help anticipate needs, coordinate work and support decisions across the property lifecycle. “The purpose of our buildings hasn’t changed.” says Helge Krogsbøl, Co-CEO at Heimstaden. “We provide homes for people. But the way we operate them continues to change as we challenge conventions and adopt new technology.”
blocks.en: The ambition is to move towards increasingly self-operating buildings, where AI can help anticipate needs, coordinate work and support decisions across the property lifecycle. “The purpose of our buildings hasn’t changed.” says Helge Krogsbøl, Co-CEO at Heimstaden. “We provide homes for people. But the way we operate them continues to change as we challenge conventions and adopt new technology.”
blocks.zh: 公司希望逐步提升楼宇的自主运营能力，让 AI 在物业全生命周期中帮助预判需求、协调工作并支持决策。Heimstaden 联席首席执行官 Helge Krogsbøl 表示：“我们楼宇的用途没有改变。”“我们为人们提供家园。但随着我们打破惯例、采用新技术，运营这些住宅的方式也在不断改变。”

blocks.text: “We see AI as one of the biggest opportunities to accelerate that transformation.”
blocks.en: “We see AI as one of the biggest opportunities to accelerate that transformation.”
blocks.zh: “我们认为，AI 是加速这一转型的最大机遇之一。”

blocks.text: Reimagining the business of letting homes
blocks.en: Reimagining the business of letting homes
blocks.zh: 重新构想住宅租赁业务

blocks.text: Consider what happens when a property becomes vacant.
blocks.en: Consider what happens when a property becomes vacant.
blocks.zh: 不妨看看一套房屋空置后需要做些什么。

blocks.text: Traditionally, getting it back onto the market involves assessing rental value, arranging photography, producing advertisements and responding to market demand. Each stage requires time, coordination and specialist input. And it is an information challenge; understanding what you own, what the competition has, and what the customer wants.
blocks.en: Traditionally, getting it back onto the market involves assessing rental value, arranging photography, producing advertisements and responding to market demand. Each stage requires time, coordination and specialist input. And it is an information challenge; understanding what you own, what the competition has, and what the customer wants.
blocks.zh: 按照传统做法，要将它重新推向市场，需要评估租金水平、安排拍摄、制作广告，并根据市场需求作出调整。每个环节都需要时间、协调和专业人员的参与。这也是一项信息挑战：要了解自己有哪些房源、竞争对手能提供什么，以及客户想要什么。

blocks.text: AI is now supporting all the key steps in this process:
blocks.en: AI is now supporting all the key steps in this process:
blocks.zh: 如今，AI 正在为这一流程中的所有关键环节提供支持：

blocks.text: Pricing: Intelligence and recommendations based on tools built in ChatGPT Sites
blocks.en: Pricing: Intelligence and recommendations based on tools built in ChatGPT Sites
blocks.zh: 定价：利用在 ChatGPT 站点中构建的工具，提供分析洞察和建议

blocks.text: Advertising: Image styling and apartment descriptions done by AI
blocks.en: Advertising: Image styling and apartment descriptions done by AI
blocks.zh: 广告制作：由 AI 完成图片风格处理和公寓描述撰写

blocks.text: Review listings: Agent reviews all live ads against Heimstaden’s quality standards
blocks.en: Review listings: Agent reviews all live ads against Heimstaden’s quality standards
blocks.zh: 房源审核：智能体根据 Heimstaden 的质量标准，审核所有已上线广告

blocks.text: Feedback: AI generated market feedback helps letting teams take corrective action which makes prices increasingly dynamic
blocks.en: Feedback: AI generated market feedback helps letting teams take corrective action which makes prices increasingly dynamic
blocks.zh: 反馈：AI 生成的市场反馈帮助租赁团队及时调整，使定价更加灵活

blocks.text: Employees remain responsible for reviewing and approving decisions. But the work surrounding those decisions is changing.
blocks.en: Employees remain responsible for reviewing and approving decisions. But the work surrounding those decisions is changing.
blocks.zh: 员工仍负责决策的审核与批准。但围绕这些决策展开的工作正在改变。

blocks.text: In the Netherlands, the cost of producing a virtually staged property image has fallen from approximately €50 to less than €0.10 which is a reduction of more than 99%. Heimstaden estimates annual savings potential of €130,000 in that market alone.
blocks.en: In the Netherlands, the cost of producing a virtually staged property image has fallen from approximately €50 to less than €0.10 which is a reduction of more than 99%. Heimstaden estimates annual savings potential of €130,000 in that market alone.
blocks.zh: 在荷兰，制作一张虚拟布置房源图片的成本，已从约 50 欧元降至不足 0.10 欧元，降幅超过 99%。Heimstaden 估计，仅在这一市场，每年就有望节省 13 万欧元。

blocks.text: The significance extends beyond cheaper advertisements. By applying AI across the letting process, Heimstaden is building a more responsive way to bring homes to market.
blocks.en: The significance extends beyond cheaper advertisements. By applying AI across the letting process, Heimstaden is building a more responsive way to bring homes to market.
blocks.zh: 其意义远不止降低广告成本。通过在租赁全流程中应用 AI，Heimstaden 正在以更灵活、响应更及时的方式将房源推向市场。

blocks.text: “Our AI strategy is based on three pillars.” says Nikolaj Brammer, Heimstaden’s Chief Digital Officer, “First, we empower employees through training and access to the right tools. Second, we have a central transformation office and a network of AI champions to drive larger AI initiatives. Third, we strengthen the foundations by making our property management systems and data models ready for AI.”
blocks.en: “Our AI strategy is based on three pillars.” says Nikolaj Brammer, Heimstaden’s Chief Digital Officer, “First, we empower employees through training and access to the right tools. Second, we have a central transformation office and a network of AI champions to drive larger AI initiatives. Third, we strengthen the foundations by making our property management systems and data models ready for AI.”
blocks.zh: Heimstaden 首席数字官 Nikolaj Brammer 表示：“我们的 AI 战略建立在三大支柱之上。首先，通过培训和提供合适的工具来赋能员工。其次，我们设有统筹转型的办公室，并建立了由 AI 推动者组成的网络，以推进更大规模的 AI 项目。第三，让物业管理系统和数据模型做好应用 AI 的准备，夯实基础。”

blocks.text: Letting puts all three pillars into practice: tools and training enable colleagues to create virtually staged images and listings; our central team coordinates improvements across pricing, advertising, ad review and market feedback; and we are making property data accessible to the AI tools that support pricing and listing creation.
blocks.en: Letting puts all three pillars into practice: tools and training enable colleagues to create virtually staged images and listings; our central team coordinates improvements across pricing, advertising, ad review and market feedback; and we are making property data accessible to the AI tools that support pricing and listing creation.
blocks.zh: 租赁业务将这三大支柱落到了实处：工具和培训让同事能够制作虚拟布置图片和房源信息；我们的中央团队统筹定价、广告制作、广告审核及市场反馈各环节的改进；同时，我们正让支持定价和房源信息制作的 AI 工具能够访问物业数据。

blocks.text: “We started by breaking down our most important business processes and asking where AI could create value. Letting is a good example: it’s not about automating one task, but improving how the whole process works.”
blocks.en: “We started by breaking down our most important business processes and asking where AI could create value. Letting is a good example: it’s not about automating one task, but improving how the whole process works.”
blocks.zh: “我们首先拆解了最重要的业务流程，并思考 AI 能在哪些环节创造价值。租赁业务就是一个很好的例子：重点不是让某一项任务自动化，而是改善整个流程的运作方式。”

blocks.text: When domain experts become builders
blocks.en: When domain experts become builders
blocks.zh: 当领域专家开始自己构建解决方案

blocks.text: Some of the most significant changes are happening far from traditional software engineering teams.
blocks.en: Some of the most significant changes are happening far from traditional software engineering teams.
blocks.zh: 一些最显著的变化，正在传统软件工程团队之外发生。

blocks.text: Heimstaden needed to assess environmental risks across its portfolio. The information existed, but was scattered across public sources, formats and datasets. Turning it into a usable assessment would have required substantial manual work and technical resources.
blocks.en: Heimstaden needed to assess environmental risks across its portfolio. The information existed, but was scattered across public sources, formats and datasets. Turning it into a usable assessment would have required substantial manual work and technical resources.
blocks.zh: Heimstaden 需要评估旗下资产组合的环境风险。相关信息虽然已经存在，却以不同格式分散在各类公开来源和数据集中。要将这些信息转化为可用的评估结果，原本需要投入大量人力和技术资源。

blocks.text: Heimstaden’s Julia Erlandsen, an environmental sustainability analyst without a software development background, used Codex to help build a different approach.
blocks.en: Heimstaden’s Julia Erlandsen, an environmental sustainability analyst without a software development background, used Codex to help build a different approach.
blocks.zh: Heimstaden 的环境可持续发展分析师 Julia Erlandsen 没有软件开发背景，却借助 Codex 开辟了另一条路径。

blocks.text: Codex supported the discovery, cleaning and standardisation of data, quality checking and the development of repeatable processing pipelines. Julia retained control over the methodology and validation.
blocks.en: Codex supported the discovery, cleaning and standardisation of data, quality checking and the development of repeatable processing pipelines. Julia retained control over the methodology and validation.
blocks.zh: Codex 协助完成了数据查找、清洗、标准化和质量检查，并帮助开发了可重复运行的数据处理流程。方法设计和结果验证仍由 Julia 把关。

blocks.text: The result: 20,112 assets assessed, more than six million rows of useful data generated, and an estimated delivery requirement reduced from five people working for a year to two people working for two months.
blocks.en: The result: 20,112 assets assessed, more than six million rows of useful data generated, and an estimated delivery requirement reduced from five people working for a year to two people working for two months.
blocks.zh: 最终，团队完成了 20,112 项资产的评估，生成了超过 600 万行有用数据，预计所需的交付投入从 5 人工作一年，缩减为 2 人工作两个月。

blocks.text: Heimstaden also avoided engaging external consultants which would otherwise have been needed to solve the problem.
blocks.en: Heimstaden also avoided engaging external consultants which would otherwise have been needed to solve the problem.
blocks.zh: Heimstaden 也因此无需聘请原本为解决这一问题所必需的外部顾问。

blocks.text: What began as a complex analytical project is becoming a repeatable capability, supporting climate-risk assessments, reporting requirements and investor decision-making.
blocks.en: What began as a complex analytical project is becoming a repeatable capability, supporting climate-risk assessments, reporting requirements and investor decision-making.
blocks.zh: 最初复杂的分析项目，正在转变为一项可重复运用的能力，为气候风险评估、报告要求和投资者决策提供支持。

blocks.text: “Codex helped us build a solution that would previously have required substantial technical support. We now own the methodology and can continue developing it ourselves.”
blocks.en: “Codex helped us build a solution that would previously have required substantial technical support. We now own the methodology and can continue developing it ourselves.”
blocks.zh: “Codex 帮助我们构建了一套解决方案，而这在过去需要大量技术支持。现在，这套方法掌握在我们自己手中，我们可以自主持续完善。”

blocks.text: Responsible AI adoption
blocks.en: Responsible AI adoption
blocks.zh: 负责任地应用 AI

blocks.text: Heimstaden’s AI adoption focuses on tasks employees need help with. After ChatGPT Enterprise launched in September 2025, half of employees were using it within two to three months. A central AI transformation office maintains a library of use cases so colleagues can learn from examples across the business.
blocks.en: Heimstaden’s AI adoption focuses on tasks employees need help with. After ChatGPT Enterprise launched in September 2025, half of employees were using it within two to three months. A central AI transformation office maintains a library of use cases so colleagues can learn from examples across the business.
blocks.zh: Heimstaden 围绕员工需要帮助的任务来推进 AI 应用。2025 年 9 月上线 ChatGPT Enterprise 后，两到三个月内就有一半员工开始使用。公司设有统筹 AI 转型的办公室，负责维护应用案例库，方便同事借鉴各业务领域的实践。

blocks.text: Employees use approved tools within rules for data security. They remain responsible for reviewing AI-generated content before sending it and for approving decisions.
blocks.en: Employees use approved tools within rules for data security. They remain responsible for reviewing AI-generated content before sending it and for approving decisions.
blocks.zh: 员工遵守数据安全规定，使用经过批准的工具。他们仍须在发送 AI 生成的内容前进行审核，并负责审批决策。

blocks.text: Adoption extends to real estate caretakers, including some who were initially sceptical. In Norway, one caretaker used ChatGPT to assess a neglected apartment and draft a prioritised refurbishment plan, turning observations into a structured plan they could review and refine.
blocks.en: Adoption extends to real estate caretakers, including some who were initially sceptical. In Norway, one caretaker used ChatGPT to assess a neglected apartment and draft a prioritised refurbishment plan, turning observations into a structured plan they could review and refine.
blocks.zh: 物业管理员也开始使用 AI，其中不乏起初持怀疑态度的人。在挪威，一位物业管理员使用 ChatGPT 评估了一套疏于维护的公寓，并草拟了按优先级排序的翻修计划，将现场观察转化为便于审核和完善的结构化方案。

blocks.text: “People across the business are finding practical ways to use AI in their daily work. Our job is to scale what works while keeping data secure, responsibilities clear and people in control.”
blocks.en: “People across the business are finding practical ways to use AI in their daily work. Our job is to scale what works while keeping data secure, responsibilities clear and people in control.”
blocks.zh: “各业务部门的同事都在探索将 AI 用于日常工作的实用方法。我们的职责是推广行之有效的做法，同时确保数据安全、职责清晰，并始终由人掌控。”

blocks.text: The next frontier: From answering questions to taking action
blocks.en: The next frontier: From answering questions to taking action
blocks.zh: 迈向下一阶段：从回答问题到执行行动

blocks.text: Heimstaden is already preparing for the next stage: AI that can work across systems and coordinate multi-step processes.
blocks.en: Heimstaden is already preparing for the next stage: AI that can work across systems and coordinate multi-step processes.
blocks.zh: Heimstaden 已在为下一阶段做准备：让 AI 跨系统工作，并协调多步骤流程。

blocks.text: Its Procurement Intelligence Platform, currently being rolled out, combines workflow automation with OpenAI models accessed through APIs. Designed to operate across Outlook, SharePoint and Teams, it supports contract analysis, negotiation preparation and contract lifecycle management, with employees retaining responsibility for commercial decisions and approvals.
blocks.en: Its Procurement Intelligence Platform, currently being rolled out, combines workflow automation with OpenAI models accessed through APIs. Designed to operate across Outlook, SharePoint and Teams, it supports contract analysis, negotiation preparation and contract lifecycle management, with employees retaining responsibility for commercial decisions and approvals.
blocks.zh: 其正在推广部署的采购智能平台，将工作流自动化与通过 API 接入的 OpenAI 模型相结合。该平台可跨 Outlook、SharePoint 和 Teams 运行，支持合同分析、谈判准备和合同全生命周期管理，而商业决策及审批仍由员工负责。

blocks.text: The longer-term ambition is more fundamental.
blocks.en: The longer-term ambition is more fundamental.
blocks.zh: 更长远的目标，则是从根本上推动变革。

blocks.text: Heimstaden is co-developing Amplio Estate, a modern property management system designed to support AI-powered workflows through MCP. The goal is to enable employees to use AI, such as ChatGPT, to retrieve property information and take action in core business systems, with appropriate human oversight.
blocks.en: Heimstaden is co-developing Amplio Estate, a modern property management system designed to support AI-powered workflows through MCP. The goal is to enable employees to use AI, such as ChatGPT, to retrieve property information and take action in core business systems, with appropriate human oversight.
blocks.zh: Heimstaden 正在联合开发 Amplio Estate，这是一套现代化物业管理系统，旨在通过 MCP 支持 AI 驱动的工作流。其目标是让员工能够使用 ChatGPT 等 AI 工具，在适当的人工监督下检索物业信息，并在核心业务系统中执行操作。

blocks.text: This is how Heimstaden begins turning the idea of self-operating buildings into a practical technology roadmap.
blocks.en: This is how Heimstaden begins turning the idea of self-operating buildings into a practical technology roadmap.
blocks.zh: 通过这些举措，Heimstaden 开始将楼宇自主运营的构想转化为切实可行的技术路线图。

blocks.text: Results at a glance
blocks.en: Results at a glance
blocks.zh: 成果速览

blocks.text: More than 99% lower image production costs in the Netherlands.
blocks.en: More than 99% lower image production costs in the Netherlands.
blocks.zh: 在荷兰，图片制作成本降低了 99% 以上。

blocks.text: 20,112 property assets assessed with Codex, reducing the estimated delivery requirement from five people over one year to two people over two months.
blocks.en: 20,112 property assets assessed with Codex, reducing the estimated delivery requirement from five people over one year to two people over two months.
blocks.zh: 借助 Codex 评估了 20,112 项物业资产，预计所需的交付投入从 5 人工作一年缩减为 2 人工作两个月。

blocks.text: 50% employee adoption within 2–3 months of rollout.
blocks.en: 50% employee adoption within 2–3 months of rollout.
blocks.zh: 上线后 2–3 个月内，员工使用率达到 50%。

blocks.text: Leadership lessons:
blocks.en: Leadership lessons:
blocks.zh: 管理启示：

blocks.text: Focus on people: Adoption and imagination are the bottlenecks (not tech)
blocks.en: Focus on people: Adoption and imagination are the bottlenecks (not tech)
blocks.zh: 以人为本：瓶颈在于应用普及和想象力，而非技术

blocks.text: Find your champions: The biggest returns come from colleagues driving change locally
blocks.en: Find your champions: The biggest returns come from colleagues driving change locally
blocks.zh: 找到变革推动者：最大的回报来自那些在各自团队中推动变革的同事

blocks.text: Get the process right: AI will not fix a broken process, but it can dramatically scale a good one.
blocks.en: Get the process right: AI will not fix a broken process, but it can dramatically scale a good one.
blocks.zh: 先理顺流程：AI 无法修复有问题的流程，却能大幅放大优良流程的价值。

blocks.text: What’s next
blocks.en: What’s next
blocks.zh: 未来展望

blocks.text: Heimstaden’s vision is not of buildings without people, but of properties supported by increasingly intelligent systems which will improve decision making for employees and increase ability to resolve matters for customers.
blocks.en: Heimstaden’s vision is not of buildings without people, but of properties supported by increasingly intelligent systems which will improve decision making for employees and increase ability to resolve matters for customers.
blocks.zh: Heimstaden 的愿景不是让楼宇脱离人的参与，而是以日益智能的系统支持物业运营，帮助员工做出更好的决策，提升为客户解决问题的能力。

blocks.text: The buildings will remain much as they have always been—homes and roofs over people’s heads. The way they’re operated has forever changed.
blocks.en: The buildings will remain much as they have always been—homes and roofs over people’s heads. The way they’re operated has forever changed.
blocks.zh: 楼宇将一如既往，为人们提供家园和遮风挡雨的居所。但其运营方式，已从此改变。

original.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI

zh.title: Heimstaden 正借助 AI 变革住宅物业管理
